questions.question: In God's law of jealousy, who did a husband bring his wife to if he suspected she was unfaithful?
In God's law of jealousy, what did the law say about the husband once the priest had applied it to his wife?

answers.text: He would be free from guilt
He would bring a ram of atonement
He would repay a fifth more

questions.question: Under God's law of jealousy, a wife who had not defiled herself would be unharmed and able to conceive children. True or false?
In God's law of jealousy, the priest burned the whole grain offering on the altar. True or false?
